home.heroSubtitle: Bioclimatic pergolas, gazebos and premium outdoor structures — designed in Paris, crafted in our Vendée workshops.

categories.title: Every structure, a bespoke piece.

why.title: One standard, every step.

craft.title: Made in France
craft.body: Workshops in Vendée, extruded and thermo-lacquered aluminium, tenth-of-a-millimetre tolerances.

warranty.title: 10-year warranty

sustainable.title: Sustainable & recyclable
sustainable.body: 100% recyclable aluminium, PEFC-certified wood, low-consumption LED.

awarded.title: Award-winning
